across individuals. The book describes intersex conditions, hormone-related development, gender identity, sexual orientation, and differences in sexual expression."},{"type":"paragraph","text":"These sections should be read as distinct questions rather than merged into one explanation. Track which evidence concerns anatomy, genes, prenatal influences, behavior, or identity and note variation within each topic."},{"type":"heading","id":"bp14-m10-2-study-1","text":"Variation is central, not an exception"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Sex-related anatomy, gender-related behavior, identity, and sexual orientation are different dimensions that should not be treated as interchangeable. The module examines biological development through conditions in which chromosomes, hormones, anatomy, or receptor responses do not follow the most common combinations. Intersex variations provide evidence about the roles of prenatal development and endocrine mechanisms, but any particular individual's experience remains more complex than one biological variable."},{"type":"heading","id":"bp14-m10-2-study-2","text":"What developmental conditions teach"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Congenital adrenal hyperplasia and androgen insensitivity are examples of circumstances that help researchers understand how hormone exposure and sensitivity relate to development. Outcomes are variable, and it is important not to infer identity from anatomy or to use clinical cases as simplistic experiments. Questions about sex assignment and upbringing have medical, ethical, and personal dimensions. A science-based answer should identify the actual biological mechanism and the limits of what a case demonstrates."},{"type":"heading","id":"bp14-m10-2-study-3","text":"Sexual orientation and its influences"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Researchers have investigated genetic patterns, prenatal influences, behavior, and neuroanatomy in relation to sexual orientation. No single factor offers a complete, deterministic account of an individual's orientation. Group-level findings do not constitute reliable tests of personal identity. Evolutionary questions about variation are research questions, not grounds for pathologizing or ranking people. Avoid equating correlation in one biological measure with proof of cause."},{"type":"heading","id":"bp14-m10-2-study-4","text":"Gender identity and interpretation"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Gender identity and gender-differentiated behaviors are studied across biological and developmental contexts. Transgender experiences cannot be reduced to a simple hormone test or one neural region. The module's recurring lesson is that human variation does not fit neatly into one dimension, and explanatory claims should preserve differences among anatomy, development, behavior, identity, and orientation. This is both scientifically more accurate and more respectful of individuals."},{"type":"heading","id":"deep-bp14-m10-2-h01","text":"Gender Identity and Gender-Differentiated Behaviors"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"However, the biologist who advised the film producers agreed that scientific accuracy on this point would have been more confusing to children than helpful .","sourcePrintedPage":339,"sourcePdfPage":357,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"The biological differences resulting from the chromosome pattern are sex differences , and the differences that result from people’s regarding themselves as male or female are gender speak of the “gender” of fish, fruit flies, and so forth.","sourcePrintedPage":339,"sourcePdfPage":357,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Troops of monkeys or .","sourcePrintedPage":339,"sourcePdfPage":357,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Most people accept the gender identity that matches their external appearance, but some do not.","sourcePrintedPage":339,"sourcePdfPage":357,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"At one time, psychologists assumed that gender identity and related behaviors depended almost entirely how parents rear their People"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"A genetic male with low levels of testosterone or testosterone receptors may develop a female or intermediate appearance.","sourcePrintedPage":339,"sourcePdfPage":357,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"A genetic female who is exposed to more testosterone than the average female can be partly masculinized.","sourcePrintedPage":339,"sourcePdfPage":357,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"The most common cause of an intermediate sexual anatomy is congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) , meaning overdevelopment of the adrenal glands.","sourcePrintedPage":339,"sourcePdfPage":357,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"The pituitary secretes adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), which stimulates the adrenal gland to release cortisol and other hormones, and cortisol feeds back to decrease ACTH.","sourcePrintedPage":339,"sourcePdfPage":357,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"If a fetus has a genetic limitation in the ability to produce cortisol, the pituitary fails to receive the usual feedback signal, and it continues secreting more ACTH, stimulating the adrenal gland beyond the usual level.","sourcePrintedPage":339,"sourcePdfPage":357,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"The accuracy of these estimates is uncertain, as hospitals and families keep the information private.","sourcePrintedPage":339,"sourcePdfPage":357,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Confidentiality is important, but an unfortunate consequence is that intersex people have trouble finding others like .","sourcePrintedPage":340,"sourcePdfPage":358,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"The girls exposed to the largest amount of testosterone in early development Appearance"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"To resolve the roles of rearing and hormones in determining gender identity, the most decisive observation would come from rearing a normal male baby as a and the parents rear her as a girl, she will fully accept that identity.","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Girls female.","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Most are reared as girls, and most are reasonably satisfied with this designation, although some consider themselves gender-fluid and many are either lesbian or bisexual.","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Rearing a CAH genetic female as male has disadvantages, including the need to surgically remove the ovaries before puberty to prevent breast growth and other female-typical developments .","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"heading","id":"deep-bp14-m10-2-h07","text":"Sexual Orientation"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Exclusive, lifelong same-sex orientation has so far been observed only in humans and sheep, although it may occur in others .","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"They choose their actions, but they do not choose their desires or orientation, any more than people choose to be left-handed or right-handed.","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Whereas most men discover their sexual orientation early, many women are slower.","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Boys’ femininetype behaviors in childhood and adolescence correlate strongly with same-sex orientation in adulthood , but girls’ masculine-type behaviors are relatively weak predictors of sexual orientation .","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Surveys report that about 3.5 percent of adults in the United States identify as gay or lesbian .","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"The percentage also varies among countries, although we do not know how much of the apparent difference is due to secrecy or inaccurate reporting.","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Even though a man may have had both same-sex and opposite-sex experiences, his preference and fantasies almost always lean strongly one way more than the other, and few men change their orientation .","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"heading","id":"deep-bp14-m10-2-h08","text":"Behavioral and Anatomical Differences"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Gay men and heterosexual men differ slightly on average in height, weight, shape of the face, sound of the voice, and ratio of the index finger to the ring finger .","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"However, let’s emphasize the terms “slightly” and “on average.” The difference in height is on average only half an inch (1.5 cm).","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"People who differ in sexual orientation also tend to differ in many behaviors not directly connected to sex.","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Gay men are more likely than average to choose female-typical careers such as florist or hair stylist .","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Also, whereas heterosexual men usually give directions in terms of distances and north, south, east, or west, women and gay men are more likely to describe landmarks .","sourcePrintedPage":342,"sourcePdfPage":360,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"heading","id":"deep-bp14-m10-2-h09","text":"Genetics"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Early studies of the genetics of human sexual orientation began by advertising in gay or lesbian publications for readers of those magazines who had twins.","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"When someone responded, the researchers contacted the other twin to fill out a survey with miscellaneous questions that included sexual orientation.","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"However, the kind of person who answers an ad in a gay or lesbian magazine is not representative of all others.","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"A later study examined the data from all the twins in Sweden between ages 20 and 47 .","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"The Swedish study differed not only in the breadth of the sample but also in the behavioral criterion.","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Instead of asking about sexual orientation, the researchers asked whether someone had ever had a same-sex partner.","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"In short, the results indicate some heritability of sexual orientation, but the size of the effect is uncertain, and the mechanism is also uncertain.","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"heading","id":"deep-bp14-m10-2-h10","text":"An Evolutionary Question"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"On average, a gay man has about one-fifth as many children as a heterosexual man.","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"That is, those who do not have children themselves might do a better than average job of helping their siblings rear children.","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Survey data in the United States indicate that gay men are no more likely, and perhaps less likely, than heterosexuals to support their relatives .","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"However, observations in Samoa found that gay men are more helpful than average toward their nephews and nieces, in ways such as baby-sitting, tutoring, or contributing money .","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"It is difficult to know what might have been the usual pattern through human existence.","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Researchers identified genes that were more common than average among people who had at least one same-sex encounter.","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"The genes that the researchers found may reflect openness to new experiences, or willingness to take risks, or just a strong sex drive, rather than samesex attraction .","sourcePrintedPage":343,"sourcePdfPage":361,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"heading","id":"deep-bp14-m10-2-h11","text":"Prenatal Influences"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"However, it is possible that sexual orientation depends on hormone levels during a sensitive period of brain development .","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Animal studies have shown that prenatal or early postnatal hormones produce organizing effects on both external anatomy and brain development, but the external anatomy develops earlier than the brain.","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Therefore, it is possible for hormones to alter the brain without changing external anatomy.","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Researchers tested mothers of gay sons with older brothers and found elevated levels of antibodies against a protein produced by the Y chromosome .","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"The sons, however, despite normal male anatomy, often responded to the presence of another male by arching their backs in the typical rat female posture for sex .","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Males that were subjected to both stress and alcohol in prenatal development had decreased male sexual behaviors as well as the increased female behaviors .","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"The long-term effects of either prenatal stress or alcohol include several changes in the structure of the nervous system .","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"However, these studies relied on women’s memories of pregnancies more than 20 years earlier.","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"In short, researchers have identified several possible biological influences on sexual orientation, but much remains unknown.","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"heading","id":"deep-bp14-m10-2-h12","text":"Brain Anatomy"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"On average, the brains of gay men resemble those of heterosexual men in most ways, but they are shifted partly in the female-typical direction for a few structures.","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"The most widely cited research concerns the third interstitial nucleus of the anterior hypothalamus (INAH-3), which is generally more than twice as large in heterosexual men as in women.","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"This area has more cells with androgen receptors in men than in women , and it probably plays a role in male sexual behavior, although the exact role is uncertain.","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"In other species it is known as the sexually dimorphic nucleus , although calling it a “nucleus” is a bit of an overstatement.","sourcePrintedPage":344,"sourcePdfPage":362,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Researchers found that the INAH-3 nucleus of homosexual men was intermediate between those of heterosexual men and heterosexual women.","sourcePrintedPage":345,"sourcePdfPage":363,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"On microscopic examination of the INAH-3, researchers found that heterosexual men had larger neurons than homosexual men but about the same number.","sourcePrintedPage":345,"sourcePdfPage":363,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"To interpret these results, we need to ask whether differences in the hypothalamus influence sexual orientation, or sexual activity influences the size of hypothalamic neurons.","sourcePrintedPage":345,"sourcePdfPage":363,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Some neurons do grow or shrink in adults because of hormones or behavioral activities .","sourcePrintedPage":345,"sourcePdfPage":363,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"heading","id":"deep-bp14-m10-2-h13","text":"Transgender People"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Transgender people are those who affirm that they were “born in the wrong body,” that although their anatomy appears male or female, they clearly identify with the other gender.","sourcePrintedPage":345,"sourcePdfPage":363,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Estimates of the prevalence of transgender people in the United States range from 0.3 to 0.6 percent, but these may be underestimates, because many transgender people prefer to avoid public identification.","sourcePrintedPage":345,"sourcePdfPage":363,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Transgender people have some interests and activities that are not typical of their birth sex, but most people with genderatypical interests or activities do not identify as transgender .","sourcePrintedPage":345,"sourcePdfPage":363,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Some aspects of brain anatomy of transgender people resemble others of their birth sex, some aspects resemble those of their experienced gender, and some are intermediate .","sourcePrintedPage":345,"sourcePdfPage":363,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"When someone reaches adolescence and requests a gender change, the the","sourcePrintedPage":346,"sourcePdfPage":364,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"heading","id":"deep-bp14-m10-2-h14","text":"In Closing: We Are Not All the Same"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"People today are more aware and generally more accepting of sexual diversity than they were in Kinsey’s time.","sourcePrintedPage":346,"sourcePdfPage":364,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Biological research will not tell us how to treat one another, but it can help us understand how we come to be different.","sourcePrintedPage":346,"sourcePdfPage":364,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"Puberty-blocking drugs (to prevent gender.","sourcePrintedPage":346,"sourcePdfPage":364,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"It is important to get informed consent, which can be tricky for adolescent still wishes to proceed, treatment can start with hormones of the desired sex.","sourcePrintedPage":346,"sourcePdfPage":364,"sourceMethod":"selected_textbook_sentence"},{"type":"paragraph","text":"On average, intersexes have IQ scores in the 110 to 125 range, well above the .","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":14},{"text":"Most people accept the gender identity that matches their external appearance, but some do not.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":15},{"text":"At one time, psychologists assumed that gender identity and related behaviors depended almost entirely how parents rear their children.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":16},{"text":"However, several kinds of evidence suggest that prenatal hormones are important also.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":17},{"text":"For fish, sexual identity is more fluid than it is for humans.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"additional_source_condensed_note","paragraphIndex":121},{"text":"(Yeah, I know, terrible pun.) appearance.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":19},{"text":"A genetic female who is exposed to more testosterone than the average female can be partly masculinized.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":20},{"text":"The most common cause of an intermediate sexual anatomy is congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) , meaning overdevelopment of the adrenal glands.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":21},{"text":"The pituitary secretes adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), which stimulates the adrenal gland to release cortisol and other hormones, and cortisol feeds back to decrease ACTH.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":22},{"text":"If a fetus has a genetic limitation in the ability to produce cortisol, the pituitary fails to receive the usual feedback signal, and it continues secreting more ACTH, stimulating the adrenal gland beyond the usual level.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":23},{"text":"The accuracy of these estimates is uncertain, as hospitals and families keep the information private.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":24},{"text":"Confidentiality is important, but an unfortunate consequence is that intersex people have trouble finding others like themselves.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":25},{"text":"The extra ACTH causes the adrenal gland to secrete extra testosterone, which has little effect on male development, but partly masculinizes the external genitals of a female.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"additional_source_condensed_note","paragraphIndex":123},{"text":"Someone with intermediate sexual development, as in Figure 10.12, is an intersex person.","printedPage":339,"pdfPage":357,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"additional_source_condensed_note","paragraphIndex":124}],"originalFacts":7,"additionalFacts":2,"glossary":[{"term":"Intersex","definition":"a .","printedPage":340,"pdfPage":358,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":30},{"text":"Observations found that the parents generally encouraged the girls .","printedPage":340,"pdfPage":358,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":32},{"text":"When the girls who had CAH reach adolescence, their interests tend magazines and fewer style and glamour magazines .","printedPage":340,"pdfPage":358,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":34},{"text":"In several studies, girls, girls with CAH are less likely to imitate what women or young girls do.","printedPage":340,"pdfPage":358,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"additional_source_condensed_note","paragraphIndex":126},{"text":"In adulthood, they are likely to express more physical aggression than most other women do, and less interest in infants.","printedPage":340,"pdfPage":358,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"additional_source_condensed_note","paragraphIndex":127},{"text":"They tend to be more interested in rough sports and driver.","printedPage":340,"pdfPage":358,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"additional_source_condensed_note","paragraphIndex":128}],"originalFacts":8,"additionalFacts":4,"glossary":[],"sourceBodyWordsAvailable":419,"sourceStatus":"source_explained","mdCrosscheck":"terms_present","wordCount":263},{"id":"bp14-m10-2-h04","title":"Testicular .","printedPage":341,"pdfPage":359,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":51},{"text":"Despite their genital anatomy, they had typical male levels of .","printedPage":342,"pdfPage":360,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":53},{"text":"The reason was that surgery to approximate female appearance is identity.","printedPage":342,"pdfPage":360,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":55},{"text":"Girls with the CAH history have a difficult sexual .","printedPage":342,"pdfPage":360,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":58},{"text":"Of the males with cloacal exstrophy who are reared as girls, nearly sensation and requires frequent attention to prevent it from scarring occur in others .","printedPage":342,"pdfPage":360,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":60},{"text":"They choose their actions, but they do not choose their desires or orientation, any more than people choose to be left-handed or right-handed.","printedPage":342,"pdfPage":360,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":61},{"text":"Whereas most men discover their sexual orientation .","printedPage":342,"pdfPage":360,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":63},{"text":"Surveys report that about 3.5 percent of adults in the United States identify as gay or lesbian .","printedPage":342,"pdfPage":360,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":64},{"text":"The percentage also varies among countries, although we do not know how much of the apparent difference is due to secrecy or inaccurate reporting.","printedPage":342,"pdfPage":360,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":65},{"text":"Even though a man may have had both same-sex and .","printedPage":342,"pdfPage":360,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":66},{"text":"Contrary to what biologists and others once assumed, same-sex genital contact occurs in nature for many animal species, and not just in those that cannot find a member of the opposite sex, or those with hormonal abnormalities.","printedPage":342,"pdfPage":360,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"additional_source_condensed_note","paragraphIndex":137},{"text":"Frans de Waal (2022), who spent his career .","printedPage":342,"pdfPage":360,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":68},{"text":"However, let’s emphasize the terms “slightly” and “on average.” The .","printedPage":342,"pdfPage":360,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":72}],"originalFacts":5,"additionalFacts":0,"glossary":[],"sourceBodyWordsAvailable":142,"sourceStatus":"source_explained","mdCrosscheck":"terms_present","wordCount":117},{"id":"bp14-m10-2-h09","title":"Genetics","level":2,"parentId":"bp14-m10-2-h07","printedPage":343,"pdfPage":361,"facts":[{"text":"Early twins.","printedPage":343,"pdfPage":361,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":74},{"text":"When someone responded, the researchers contacted the other orientation.","printedPage":343,"pdfPage":361,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":75},{"text":"However, the kind of person who answers an ad in a gay or lesbian magazine is not representative of all others.","printedPage":343,"pdfPage":361,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":76},{"text":"A later study examined the data from all the twins in Sweden between ages 20 and 47 .","printedPage":343,"pdfPage":361,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":77},{"text":"The Swedish study differed not only in the breadth of the sample but also in the behavioral criterion.","printedPage":343,"pdfPage":361,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":78},{"text":"Instead of asking about sexual orientation, the researchers asked whether someone had ever had a same-sex partner.","printedPage":343,"pdfPage":361,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":79},{"text":"In short, the results indicate some heritability of sexual orientation, but the size of the effect is uncertain, and the mechanism is also uncertain.","printedPage":343,"pdfPage":361,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":80},{"text":"Note, this does not say that monozygotic twins are more likely to have a same-sex orientation than dizygotic twins are.","printedPage":343,"pdfPage":361,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"additional_source_condensed_note","paragraphIndex":139},{"text":"It says that monozygotic twins are more likely to have the same sexual .","printedPage":343,"pdfPage":361,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":84},{"text":"However, observations in Samoa found that gay men are more helpful .","printedPage":343,"pdfPage":361,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":85},{"text":"It is difficult to know what might have been the usual pattern .","printedPage":343,"pdfPage":361,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":88},{"text":"A second idea is that sexual orientation relates to epigenetics .","printedPage":344,"pdfPage":362,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":93},{"text":"The sons, however, despite normal male anatomy, often responded to .","printedPage":344,"pdfPage":362,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":94},{"text":"Males that were subjected to both stress and alcohol in prenatal .","printedPage":344,"pdfPage":362,"source":"user_uploaded_pdf","method":"selected_textbook_sentence","paragraphIndex":95},{"text":"The long-term effects of either prenatal stress or alcohol include these studies relied on women’s memories of pregnancies more than 20 years Troops of monkeys or chimpanzees demonstrate different expectations for males and females, and in those cases it is reasonable to talk about gender, as well as gender nonconforming behavior.","Most people accept the gender identity that matches their external appearance, but some do not.","At one time, psychologists assumed that gender identity and related behaviors depended almost entirely how parents rear their children. However, several kinds of evidence suggest that prenatal hormones are important also.","A genetic male with low levels of testosterone or testosterone receptors may develop a female or intermediate appearance.","A genetic female who is exposed to more testosterone than the average female can be partly masculinized.","The most common cause of an intermediate sexual anatomy is congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH), meaning overdevelopment of the adrenal glands. The pituitary secretes adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH), which stimulates the adrenal gland to release cortisol and other hormones, and cortisol feeds back to decrease ACTH.","If a fetus has a genetic limitation in the ability to produce cortisol, the pituitary fails to receive the usual feedback signal, and it continues secreting more ACTH, stimulating the adrenal gland beyond the usual level.","The accuracy of these estimates is uncertain, as hospitals and families keep the information private. Confidentiality is important, but an unfortunate consequence is that intersex people have trouble finding others like themselves.","However, their brains were exposed to elevated testosterone levels during prenatal and early postnatal life.","As discussed in the first module of this chapter, prenatal levels of testosterone correlate with girls’ toy choices.","The girls with CAH played with boys’ toys more than most other girls did, but less than the average for boys. The girls exposed to the largest amount of testosterone in early development showed the largest preference for boys’ toys.","Observations found that the parents generally encouraged the girls to play with whatever they wanted to play with.","Another difference is that on average, girls with CAH also perform slightly better than most other girls on spatial and mechanical skills.","When the girls who had CAH reach adolescence, their interests tend to be intermediate between those of typical males and females. Compared to other girls, they tend to read more sports magazines and fewer style and glamour magazines.","If someone with an XY chromosome pattern has a deficiency in the receptor for androgens, circulating androgens have little or no effect.","This condition, known as androgen insensitivity or testicular feminization, produces an anatomy ranging from a smaller than average penis to an external appearance of a typical female, in which case no one has any reason to suspect the person is anything other than female, until puberty. Then, although the breasts develop and hips broaden, menstruation does not occur, because the body has undescended testes instead of ovaries and a uterus.","Also, pubic hair is sparse or absent, because it depends on androgens in females as well as males.","To resolve the roles of rearing and hormones in determining gender identity, the most decisive observation would come from rearing a normal male baby as a female or rearing a normal female baby as a male.","If the resulting adult fully accepts the assigned role, we would know that upbringing determines gender identity.","Although no one would perform such an experiment intentionally, we can learn from accidental events. In some cases, someone was exposed to a more-or-less normal pattern of male hormones in early development but then reared as a girl.","The girl-turned-boy developed a male gender identity and directed his sexual interest toward females.","Later results from 44 countries found that many but not all such people changed their identity from female to male during adolescence, with percentages that vary across countries.","However, the point is that it was a mistake to impose surgery and hormonal treatments to try to force this child to become female. When the prenatal hormone pattern of the brain conflicts with a child’s appearance, no one can be sure how that child will develop psychologically.","Girls with CAH and related conditions are born with appearances ranging from almost typical female to a partly masculinized external appearance.","Some genetic males are born with a very small penis because of a condition called cloacal exstrophy, a defect of pelvis development.","Despite their genital anatomy, they had typical male levels of testosterone in prenatal development.","genitals should be reared as a girl, using surgery if necessary to make the genitals look more feminine. The reason was that surgery to approximate female appearance is easier than surgery to approximate male appearance.","Physicians and psychologists assumed that if a child looks like a girl and the parents rear her as a girl, she will fully accept that identity.","Girls with the CAH history have a difficult sexual adjustment, especially if they were subjected to clitorisreduction surgery to make them look more female. Most are reared as girls, and most are reasonably satisfied with this designation, although some consider themselves gender-fluid and many are either lesbian or bisexual.","Rearing a CAH genetic female as male has disadvantages, including the need to surgically remove the ovaries before puberty to prevent breast growth and other female-typical developments.","Exclusive, lifelong same-sex orientation has so far been observed only in humans and sheep, although it may occur in others.","They choose their actions, but they do not choose their desires or orientation, any more than people choose to be left-handed or right-handed.","Whereas most men discover their sexual orientation early, many women are slower. Boys’ femininetype behaviors in childhood and adolescence correlate strongly with same-sex orientation in adulthood, but girls’ masculine-type behaviors are relatively weak predictors of sexual orientation.","Surveys report that about 3.5 percent of adults in the United States identify as gay or lesbian.","The percentage also varies among countries, although we do not know how much of the apparent difference is due to secrecy or inaccurate reporting. Even though a man may have had both same-sex and opposite-sex experiences, his preference and fantasies almost always lean strongly one way more than the other, and few men change their orientation.","Gay men and heterosexual men differ slightly on average in height, weight, shape of the face, sound of the voice, and ratio of the index finger to the ring finger.","However, let’s emphasize the terms “slightly” and “on average.” The difference in height is on average only half an inch (1.5 cm).","People who differ in sexual orientation also tend to differ in many behaviors not directly connected to sex. Gay men are more likely than average to choose female-typical careers such as florist or hair stylist.","Also, whereas heterosexual men usually give directions in terms of distances and north, south, east, or west, women and gay men are more likely to describe landmarks.","Early studies of the genetics of human sexual orientation began by advertising in gay or lesbian publications for readers of those magazines who had twins.","When someone responded, the researchers contacted the other twin to fill out a survey with miscellaneous questions that included sexual orientation.","However, the kind of person who answers an ad in a gay or lesbian magazine is not representative of all others. A later study examined the data from all the twins in Sweden between ages 20 and 47.","The Swedish study differed not only in the breadth of the sample but also in the behavioral criterion.","Instead of asking about sexual orientation, the researchers asked whether someone had ever had a same-sex partner. In short, the results indicate some heritability of sexual orientation, but the size of the effect is uncertain, and the mechanism is also uncertain.","On average, a gay man has about one-fifth as many children as a heterosexual man.","That is, those who do not have children themselves might do a better than average job of helping their siblings rear children.","Survey data in the United States indicate that gay men are no more likely, and perhaps less likely, than heterosexuals to support their relatives. However, observations in Samoa found that gay men are more helpful than average toward their nephews and nieces, in ways such as baby-sitting, tutoring, or contributing money.","It is difficult to know what might have been the usual pattern through human existence.","Researchers identified genes that were more common than average among people who had at least one same-sex encounter. The genes that the researchers found may reflect openness to new experiences, or willingness to take risks, or just a strong sex drive, rather than samesex attraction.","However, it is possible that sexual orientation depends on hormone levels during a sensitive period of brain development.","Animal studies have shown that prenatal or early postnatal hormones produce organizing effects on both external anatomy and brain development, but the external anatomy develops earlier than the brain.","Therefore, it is possible for hormones to alter the brain without changing external anatomy.","Researchers tested mothers of gay sons with older brothers and found elevated levels of antibodies against a protein produced by the Y chromosome. The sons, however, despite normal male anatomy, often responded to the presence of another male by arching their backs in the typical rat female posture for sex.","Males that were subjected to both stress and alcohol in prenatal development had decreased male sexual behaviors as well as the increased female behaviors.","The long-term effects of either prenatal stress or alcohol include several changes in the structure of the nervous system. However, these studies relied on women’s memories of pregnancies more than 20 years earlier.","In short, researchers have identified several possible biological influences on sexual orientation, but much remains unknown.","On average, the brains of gay men resemble those of heterosexual men in most ways, but they are shifted partly in the female-typical direction for a few structures.","The most widely cited research concerns the third interstitial nucleus of the anterior hypothalamus (INAH-3), which is generally more than twice as large in heterosexual men as in women.","This area has more cells with androgen receptors in men than in women, and it probably plays a role in male sexual behavior, although the exact role is uncertain. In other species it is known as the sexually dimorphic nucleus, although calling it a “nucleus” is a bit of an overstatement.","Researchers found that the INAH-3 nucleus of homosexual men was intermediate between those of heterosexual men and heterosexual women.","On microscopic examination of the INAH-3, researchers found that heterosexual men had larger neurons than homosexual men but about the same number.","To interpret these results, we need to ask whether differences in the hypothalamus influence sexual orientation, or sexual activity influences the size of hypothalamic neurons. Some neurons do grow or shrink in adults because of hormones or behavioral activities.","Transgender people are those who affirm that they were “born in the wrong body,” that although their anatomy appears male or female, they clearly identify with the other gender.","Estimates of the prevalence of transgender people in the United States range from 0.3 to 0.6 percent, but these may be underestimates, because many transgender people prefer to avoid public identification.","Transgender people have some interests and activities that are not typical of their birth sex, but most people with genderatypical interests or activities do not identify as transgender. Some aspects of brain anatomy of transgender people resemble others of their birth sex, some aspects resemble those of their experienced gender, and some are intermediate.","When someone reaches adolescence and requests a gender change, the recommendation is as follows: It is unwise to make irreversible physical changes at once, because many children who say they want to be the opposite sex change their mind during the","People today are more aware and generally more accepting of sexual diversity than they were in Kinsey’s time.","Biological research will not tell us how to treat one another, but it can help us understand how we come to be different.","Puberty-blocking drugs (to prevent body changes corresponding to the original, rejected sex) can be given to children at least 12 years old who have intense distress about their assigned gender.","It is important to get informed consent, which can be tricky for 12-year-olds, and some have regretted their decision later.
